The following events took place '''3668 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A [[Capture of the Dread Masters|mission]] organized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] and [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]], and commanded by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] infiltrates the [[Dread Masters]]' vessel to capture them.<ref name="Journal">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
*The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] Dread Masters are presumed killed, while being secretly transported to a Republic prison on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Journal" /><ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
